comments: What kind of weird resolution or profile are you visiting to make this happen? It gets nowhere near it for me. (I'm guessing very high UI scale)

I think the problem is that the button can't be used in profile overlay, so I'm sending it here. If it needs to be start a new issues separately, I will do it

For reproduce, try show my profile in production server but not dev server. Some player pages will trigger this problem. For me, it always happened on my page

I don't know what the conditions that would cause this problem have in common

but in my video, you can see button is blocked by a box in my profile, but another profile is worked
@cdwcgt i checked your profile specifically, on release, and still am unable to reproduce

Hmm, I have managed to reproduce something in the master branch. You can't press that button in a specific area. And I think it's what @cdwcgt is trying to explain(?). Judging by the hitbox, it feels like `ProfileSectionTabControl` "is absorbing/cancelling the click on the button (hover included)" (I'm not exactly sure if that's what's happening, but that's the best I can explain it with):
![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/43073074/dbf7519b-15ae-40ec-928b-b35b7c9bc34d)
The button in question works if I click it outside the marked rectangle.

It probably needs to be opened as a new issue. Let me know.
That is indeed a separate issue caused by completely different code. Please open separately.

review_comments: I'm not super sure this is strictly required, but I guess for the sake of consistent UX it shouldn't be a big deal to apply this here too. I couldn't break it in my brief testing at least.
